sentences.en: Mr. Holman, we're speaking to you at a really interesting and important moment in the work that you've overseen for the president, which is securing the border.
sentences.zh: 霍曼先生，我们采访您的这个时刻，在您为总统监督的工作中，即确保边境安全方面，是一个非常有趣且重要的时刻。

sentences.en: You've done that very successfully.
sentences.zh: 您在这方面做得非常成功。

sentences.en: You've brought border crossings down to historic lows.
sentences.zh: 您已将边境越境人数降至历史最低水平。

sentences.en: So what we want to do today is talk to you about the second half of that work, which is detaining and deporting illegal immigrants living and working inside of the country.
sentences.zh: 所以我们今天想和您谈谈这项工作的后半部分，即拘留和驱逐居住在境内并在此工作的非法移民。

sentences.en: Because that's where you've bumped into some real challenges.

sentences.en: Some wider pushback in protests, most notably in Los Angeles, but also elsewhere.

sentences.en: Can you just start by talking us through your goals here?

sentences.en: Are you trying to deport every single person who's here illegally?
sentences.zh: 您是想驱逐每一个非法居留在这里的人吗？

sentences.en: Entering this country illegally is a crime.

sentences.en: And we need to enforce those laws because if we don't, we send a message to the whole world, you can go ahead and enter this country illegally.

sentences.zh: 我们也优先处理那些行动。

sentences.en: No, it's based on a lot of evidence gathering, a lot of information on who we hit.
sentences.zh: 不，这是基于大量的证据收集，以及关于我们打击对象的详尽信息。

sentences.en: So it's never going to go away.
sentences.zh: 所以这种行动永远不会消失。

sentences.zh: 它肯定会减少，因为我们有更多的特工被分配到监狱里。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So you would be operating on both of those fronts either way.
sentences.zh: 所以无论如何，你们都会在这两条战线上同时行动。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So Trump won the election on the promise to do mass deportations.
sentences.zh: 特朗普赢得大选的承诺之一就是进行大规模驱逐。

sentences.en: But I want to talk about the polls here because while polls show a majority of Americans support
sentences.zh: 但我想谈谈民调，因为虽然民调显示大多数美国人支持

sentences.en: What do you say to people who say, look, we voted for deporting all the violent criminals, but not for this more sweeping campaign to deport everyone here illegally?
sentences.zh: 对于那些说“我们投票支持驱逐所有暴力罪犯，但不支持这种更广泛的驱逐非法居留者运动”的人，你怎么看？

sentences.en: President was clear on his campaign promise to secure the border, which have the most secure border in a lifetime, and running a massive deportation operation.
sentences.zh: 总统在竞选承诺中明确表示要确保边境安全，实现有史以来最安全的边境，并开展大规模的驱逐行动。

sentences.en: That's what we're doing.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们正在做的事情。

sentences.en: If people don't like what ICE is doing, then call your senator.
sentences.zh: 如果人们不喜欢移民及海关执法局（ICE）的做法，那就给你们的参议员打电话。

sentences.en: Call your congressman.
sentences.zh: 给你们的国会议员打电话。

sentences.en: ICE isn't making this up.
sentences.zh: ICE并不是在胡编乱造。

sentences.en: We're enforcing the laws enacted by Congress and signed by president.
sentences.zh: 我们是在执行国会颁布、总统签署的法律。

sentences.en: You know, everybody attacking ICE right now.
sentences.zh: 你知道，现在每个人都在攻击ICE。

sentences.en: And here's what I find interesting.
sentences.zh: 我发现有趣的是这一点。

sentences.en: If you don't like what ICE officers are out there doing right now, why aren't you on Capitol
sentences.zh: 如果你不喜欢ICE特工现在所做的事情，为什么你不去国会

sentences.en: Hill asking for immigration changes?
sentences.zh: 山要求进行移民改革呢？

sentences.en: Why aren't you protesting Immigration Corps?
sentences.zh: 为什么不去抗议移民局呢？

sentences.en: Because ICE is doing two things.
sentences.zh: 因为ICE在做两件事。

sentences.en: They're enforcing the laws enacted by Congress, and they get funded to do.
sentences.zh: 第一，他们在执行国会颁布的法律，这也是他们的职责所在。

sentences.en: And number two, they're working on an immigration federal judge who ordered this person to be removed, so they're executing the order of removals.
sentences.zh: 第二，他们正在执行联邦法官下达的驱逐令，所以他们是在依法办事。

sentences.en: ICE is just doing the job.
sentences.zh: ICE只是在履行职责。

sentences.en: And look, the innocent illegal immigration, the non-criminalists, they just entered the country illegally for a better life.
sentences.zh: 听着，那些无辜的非法移民，非犯罪分子，他们只是为了更好的生活而非法进入这个国家。

sentences.en: When that happens, it overwhelms the Border Patrol.
sentences.zh: 当这种情况发生时，边境巡逻队就会不堪重负。

sentences.en: The national security is gone because Fat and All comes across, killed hundreds of thousands of Americans.
sentences.zh: 国家安全荡然无存，因为芬太尼涌入，导致数十万美国人丧生。

sentences.en: Sex trafficking increased tenfold.
sentences.zh: 性贩运增加了十倍。

sentences.en: All those bad things happen because of innocent illegal immigration, people want to call it.
sentences.zh: 所有这些恶果都是由人们口中所谓的“无辜非法移民”造成的。

sentences.en: While everybody's fighting for it in defense of illegal aliens, there are millions of people
sentences.zh: 当每个人都在为非法移民辩护时，有数百万人

sentences.en: standing in line, taking their tests, doing their background investigation, paying their fees, doing things the right way.
sentences.zh: 正在排队，参加考试，接受背景调查，缴纳费用，以正确的方式行事。

sentences.en: And let me add this.
sentences.zh: 让我补充一点。

sentences.en: In addition, there are thousands and thousands of people in this world who really are escaping fear and persecution from their home government.
sentences.zh: 此外，世界上还有成千上万的人确实是在逃避本国政府的恐惧和迫害。

sentences.en: They're sitting in the backseat because all the cheaters have overrun the system and pushed the system back for several years.
sentences.zh: 他们只能排在后面，因为所有投机取巧的人都挤垮了系统，导致系统滞后了好几年。

sentences.en: So we have to be a nation of laws.
sentences.zh: 所以我们必须成为一个法治国家。

sentences.en: We've got to send a message to the whole world.
sentences.zh: 我们必须向全世界传达一个信息。

sentences.en: There's a right way and wrong way to come here.
sentences.zh: 来到这里有正确的方式，也有错误的方式。

sentences.en: You can still make an asylum claim, but you've got to do it the right way.
sentences.zh: 你仍然可以申请庇护，但必须通过正确的方式。

sentences.en: You don't do it by entering the country illegally.
sentences.zh: 不能通过非法入境的方式。

sentences.en: And what I hear you saying is that basically the people who are not violent criminals, whose crime is to cross illegally, that that is related to public safety because of the need
sentences.zh: 我听你的意思是，基本上那些非暴力罪犯，其罪行仅是非法越境，这也与公共安全有关，因为需要

sentences.en: to kind of be this nation of laws.
sentences.zh: 维护法治国家的地位。

sentences.en: I'm just not sure a lot of people see it that way because we are seeing people talk to their representatives.
sentences.zh: 我不确定很多人是否这样看，因为我们看到人们在与他们的代表沟通。

sentences.en: We're seeing these really big protests, Mr. Holman, which I know you've seen.
sentences.zh: 霍尔曼先生，我们看到了这些大规模的抗议活动，我知道你也看到了。

sentences.en: We've seen, you know, people go on the streets to voice their concerns about this.

sentences.zh: 我认为他们试图传达的是他们不想要这一切。

sentences.en: And I wonder what you say to that, to those protesters.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你对那些抗议者有什么回应。

sentences.en: I would ask them, what laws do you not want DEA to enforce?
sentences.zh: 我会问他们，你们不希望缉毒局（DEA）执行哪些法律？

sentences.en: What laws do you want FBI not to enforce?
sentences.zh: 你们希望联邦调查局（FBI）不要执行哪些法律？

sentences.en: What law do you ask your local police department to enforce?
sentences.zh: 你们要求当地警察局执行什么法律？

sentences.en: We don't pick and choose what we enforce.
sentences.zh: 我们不会选择性执法。

sentences.en: We're here to enforce the law.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里是为了执行法律。

sentences.en: Illegal immigration is not the answer because, again, people don't understand there's a whole ugly underbelly of illegal immigration.
sentences.zh: 非法移民不是答案，因为人们不了解非法移民背后还有极其丑陋的一面。

sentences.en: I've done this since 1984.
sentences.zh: 我从1984年就开始做这项工作了。

sentences.en: I've sent them back a tractor trailer with 19 dead aliens who baked to death, including a five-year-old little boy.
sentences.zh: 我曾送回一辆拖车，里面有19名被活活闷死的非法移民，其中包括一个五岁的小男孩。

sentences.en: I've talked to little girls as young as nine that were raped multiple times by members of the cartel.
sentences.zh: 我曾与年仅九岁的小女孩交谈，她们被贩毒集团成员多次强奸。

sentences.en: I have seen babies getting CPR in the river.
sentences.zh: 我见过婴儿在河里接受心肺复苏。

sentences.en: I've seen enough dead children, enough dead aliens in my career that it's created the person you're talking to today.
sentences.zh: 我的职业生涯中见过太多的死孩子、太多的死者，这造就了今天坐在你面前的我。

sentences.en: I wish people could wear my shoes for the last 40 years and see what I've seen, and they would agree with me.
sentences.zh: 我希望人们能穿上我的鞋子走过这40年，看看我所看到的一切，他们就会同意我的观点。

sentences.en: Illegal immigration is not a victimless crime.
sentences.zh: 非法移民不是无受害者的犯罪。

sentences.en: A secure border saves lives.
sentences.zh: 安全的边境可以挽救生命。

sentences.en: No, I hear you.
sentences.zh: 不，我听到了。

sentences.en: And I mean, look, I spent a lot of time reporting from Mexico and reporting at the border, and
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，听着，我花了很多时间在墨西哥和边境进行报道，

sentences.en: I can completely understand how having a secure border affects this trafficking that you are concerned about and that you've seen over the course of your career.
sentences.zh: 我完全理解拥有一个安全的边境如何影响你所担心的、以及你在职业生涯中见证的那些贩运活动。

sentences.en: I think the question that people who are on the streets are asking is, how does breaking up a family or uprooting a person who has been here for a long time, who is not seen as
sentences.zh: 我想街上的人们提出的问题是，拆散一个家庭或将一个在这里生活了很久、并没有被视为

sentences.en: causing a lot of problems, how does that affect the problems that you're talking about?
sentences.zh: 制造很多麻烦的人连根拔起，这怎么能解决你所谈论的问题呢？

sentences.en: Well, we've got to look at the results, right?
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们得看看结果，对吧？

sentences.en: Look at the data from ICE.
sentences.zh: 看看ICE的数据。

sentences.en: Right now, just under 130,000 arrests, close to 75% of them have a criminal record of pending criminal charges.
sentences.zh: 目前，在不到13万次的逮捕中，近75%的人有犯罪记录或未决刑事指控。

sentences.en: We are prioritizing the right way.
sentences.zh: 我们正在以正确的方式设定优先级。

sentences.en: But we aren't going to send a message that it's okay to be here illegally, because that just brings more.
sentences.zh: 但我们不会传达“非法居留是可以接受的”这种信息，因为那只会引来更多人。

sentences.en: Before we start bailing water out, we had to plug the hole.
sentences.zh: 在我们开始往外舀水之前，必须先堵住漏洞。

sentences.en: We plugged the hole.
sentences.zh: 我们已经堵住了漏洞。

sentences.en: But we've got to send a message.
sentences.zh: 但我们必须传达一个信息。

sentences.en: There's a right way and wrong way to come to this country.
sentences.zh: 来到这个国家有正确的方式，也有错误的方式。

sentences.en: Because if we say, starting today, we're only going to arrest illegal aliens convicted of a crime.
sentences.zh: 因为如果我们说，从今天开始，我们只逮捕犯了罪的非法移民。

sentences.en: Everybody else, don't worry about it.
sentences.zh: 其他人，不用担心。

sentences.en: We're not looking for it.
sentences.zh: 我们不会找你们麻烦。

sentences.en: You're saying that would send the wrong message?
sentences.zh: 你是说那会传达错误的信息吗？

sentences.en: To the entire world who wants to come to the greatest nation on earth?
sentences.zh: 传达给全世界所有想来到这个地球上最伟大国家的人？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温纳卢。

sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏中的《Connections》谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.zh: 这传达了什么信息？

sentences.zh: 这确实感觉比我们以前看到的更激进。

sentences.en: We've been clear from day one.
sentences.zh: 我们从第一天起就说得很清楚。

sentences.zh: 你们可以尽情抗议。

sentences.en: You cannot like ICE.
sentences.zh: 你们可以不喜欢ICE。

sentences.zh: 你们可以讨厌特朗普。

sentences.zh: 你们可以讨厌任何东西。

sentences.en: But you can't cross that line in interfering in a law enforcement operation.
sentences.zh: 但你们不能越界干扰执法行动。

sentences.en: It's unfortunate.
sentences.zh: 这很不幸。

sentences.zh: 这些候选人公开露面是因为他们都想博眼球，说“看我，我在挑战ICE”，在我看来这真的很恶心。

sentences.en: Where were they when half a million kids got smuggled in this country and separated from their families?
sentences.zh: 当五十万儿童被走私到这个国家并与家人分离时，他们在哪里？

sentences.en: Where were they when millions of people had been released to the United States without proper vetting?
sentences.zh: 当数百万人未经适当审查就被释放到美国时，他们在哪里？

sentences.en: Where were they then?
sentences.zh: 那时候他们在哪里？

sentences.zh: 我感到恶心的是，任何民选官员或政客，为什么执法者成了坏人，而违法者却成了受害者？

sentences.en: The whole world's upside down on this.
sentences.zh: 在这件事上，整个世界都颠倒了。

sentences.en: The men and women of ICE who I commanded them, I was the first ICE director who actually came up to the ranks.
sentences.zh: ICE的男男女女，我指挥过他们，我是第一位真正从基层升上来的ICE局长。

sentences.en: They're mothers and fathers, too.
sentences.zh: 他们也是母亲和父亲。

sentences.zh: 他们也有孩子。

sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.zh: 他们也有父母。

sentences.en: They don't hang their heart on the hook of their home when they go to work.
sentences.zh: 他们工作时并不会把心挂在家里。

sentences.en: They go home with terrible, terrible things every day.
sentences.zh: 他们每天回家都要面对极其可怕的事情。

sentences.en: These men and women are putting their lives on the line to enforce the law Congress would tell them to enforce.
sentences.zh: 这些男男女女冒着生命危险去执行国会要求他们执行的法律。

sentences.en: And they're executing orders issued by a federal judge saying that person needs to be arrested and deported.
sentences.zh: 他们正在执行联邦法官下达的命令，即某人需要被逮捕和驱逐。

sentences.en: That is what they're doing.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们正在做的事情。

sentences.en: This attempt at, you know, attacking ICE and getting on TV.
sentences.zh: 这种攻击ICE并试图上电视的行为。

sentences.en: Boy, look at me.
sentences.zh: 天哪，看看我。

sentences.en: I'm taking on ICE.
sentences.zh: 我在挑战ICE。

sentences.en: It's just disgusting.
sentences.zh: 这真是太恶心了。

sentences.zh: 加州的参议员，他本可以和部长开个会。

sentences.zh: 你们所有人要做的就是以正确的方式行事。

sentences.en: Hey, this guy running for political office, why didn't he ask for a meeting with ICE?
sentences.zh: 嘿，这个竞选公职的人，他为什么不要求和ICE会面？

sentences.zh: 他会面后说，你们要去哪？

sentences.zh: 你们要把他们带到哪去？

sentences.en: I'll meet you there.
sentences.zh: 我在那儿等你们。

sentences.zh: 我有问题要问。

sentences.zh: 但他们表现得非常激进，因为他们在寻求聚光灯。

sentences.zh: ICE官员的照片被贴在树上和电线杆上。

sentences.zh: 死亡威胁层出不穷。

sentences.en: I know because I've been doxed a thousand times myself.
sentences.zh: 我对此很清楚，因为我自己也被人肉搜索过上千次。

sentences.en: I accept it.
sentences.zh: 我接受这一点。

sentences.en: And the borders are.
sentences.zh: 而边境问题则是……

sentences.en: I don't really care what people think about me.
sentences.zh: 我并不太在意人们怎么看我。

sentences.en: The bottom line is, these men and women not only have a dangerous job already, it's made much more dangerous by the false rhetoric being pushed out there by a lot of the media
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这些人不仅已经从事着一份危险的工作，而且由于许多媒体和许多开放边境倡导者所散布的虚假言论，这份工作变得更加危险了。

sentences.en: and a lot of the open borders advocates.
sentences.zh: 还有许多开放边境的倡导者。

sentences.en: They're doing the best job they can in difficult circumstances, and I stand by that.
sentences.zh: 他们在困难的情况下尽职尽责，我支持这一点。

sentences.en: It's not being aggressive.
sentences.zh: 这并非咄咄逼人。

sentences.en: It's about being safe and enforcing the law in a difficult situation.
sentences.zh: 这是为了确保安全，并在困难的情况下执行法律。

sentences.en: And you said this isn't about an intimidation, that this is about safety for your ICE officers.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说这并非为了恐吓，而是为了ICE官员的安全。

sentences.en: I'm curious, though, just in a perfect world for you, does everyone here illegally see what you're doing, see these raids and say, look, that's not how I want to leave the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但我很好奇，在你理想的世界里，每一个非法居留的人看到你们的所作所为，看到这些突袭行动时，会不会想：看，我不想以这种方式离开美国。

sentences.en: I would rather self-deport.
sentences.zh: 我宁愿主动离境。

sentences.en: I would rather do this on my own accord.
sentences.zh: 我宁愿自愿这样做。

sentences.en: Is that the ideal scenario in your mind?
sentences.zh: 在你看来，这是理想的情况吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: We've spent a lot of money advertising that in several different languages.
sentences.zh: 我们已经花了很多钱用多种语言进行宣传。

sentences.en: Work with ICE.
sentences.zh: 与ICE合作。

sentences.en: Get your affairs in order, wherever that is.
sentences.zh: 处理好你的事务，无论是在哪里。

sentences.en: Work with ICE.
sentences.zh: 与ICE合作。

sentences.en: We'll get you a free airline ticket home, and we'll give you $1,000 when you land.
sentences.zh: 我们会为你提供一张免费的返程机票，当你落地时，我们还会给你1000美元。

sentences.en: We want to do it that way.
sentences.zh: 我们希望以这种方式解决。

sentences.en: And if they do it that way, they leave themselves open to opportunity, come back with a visitor's visa, tourist visa.
sentences.zh: 如果他们这样做，他们就为自己留下了机会，以后还可以持访问签证或旅游签证回来。

sentences.en: Maybe they have a U.S.
sentences.zh: 也许他们有一个美国籍的孩子，

sentences.en: citizen child that when they turn of age, they can petition for the parent.
sentences.zh: 等孩子成年后，他们可以为父母申请身份。

sentences.en: There's other legal avenues they can take advantage of.
sentences.zh: 还有其他合法的途径可以利用。

sentences.en: But if we have to go seek you, we have to go through the formal deportation process,
sentences.zh: 但如果我们必须去搜捕你，我们就得走正式的驱逐出境程序，

sentences.en: there's a statutory bar in federal law in a way from 5 to 20 years where you can't come
sentences.zh: 联邦法律中有一项法定限制，规定在5到20年内你不能

sentences.en: back under any legal program.
sentences.zh: 通过任何合法项目回来。

sentences.en: So make it so easier for yourself and work with ICE and leave and make other opportunities available to you.
sentences.zh: 所以，让自己轻松一点，与ICE合作，主动离开，这样你还能拥有其他机会。

sentences.en: I think my question was really about the kind of images that are coming out of these raids and whether there is a message being sent by the aggressiveness of the approach, which
sentences.zh: 我想我的问题其实是关于这些突袭行动所呈现出的形象，以及这种激进的做法是否在传递某种信息，即

sentences.en: is, look, if you don't want to be swept up in one of these raids, go on your own accord.
sentences.zh: 看，如果你不想在这些突袭中被抓，那就自愿离开。

sentences.en: And do you see the kind of aggressive tactics as sending a message, sending that message specifically?
sentences.zh: 你认为这种激进的策略是在传递信息吗？是在专门传递那种信息吗？

sentences.en: I don't agree with the term aggressive tactics.
sentences.zh: 我不同意“激进策略”这个说法。

sentences.en: They're doing the same taxes that I've done starting in 1984.
sentences.zh: 他们执行的正是从1984年起我就在执行的那些任务。

sentences.en: ICE is trying to do the job.
sentences.zh: ICE只是在努力工作。

sentences.en: So enforcing law is aggressive.
sentences.zh: 所以执行法律就是激进吗？

sentences.en: I disagree with the term aggressive.
sentences.zh: 我不同意“激进”这个词。

sentences.en: I think they're doing it in a real professional manner.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们是以非常专业的方式在执行任务。

sentences.en: Despite all the hate they're taking, all the threats they're taking, they're taking extra measures now.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们承受着所有的仇恨和威胁，但他们现在采取了额外的预防措施。

sentences.en: I'll give you that.
sentences.zh: 这一点我承认。

sentences.en: They're sending more officers in the zone for officer safety reasons.
sentences.zh: 出于警员安全考虑，他们正在向该区域派遣更多警员。

sentences.en: But that's because of the threats that's being leveled against them.
sentences.zh: 但这正是因为针对他们的威胁在不断升级。

sentences.en: I am just aware that in some ways the fear that is generated by these actions can be helpful to achieving that aim of getting people to self-deport.
sentences.zh: 我只是意识到，在某种程度上，这些行动所产生的恐惧感可能有助于实现让人们主动离境这一目标。

sentences.en: I mean, we know one effect of these raids is that people in these communities, they are afraid, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们知道这些突袭的一个影响是，社区里的人们感到害怕，对吧？

sentences.en: Based on our reporting.
sentences.zh: 根据我们的报道。

sentences.en: There is fear that is generated.
sentences.zh: 确实产生了恐惧。

sentences.en: And that could lead to the result that you're saying you want.
sentences.zh: 而这可能会导致你所说的那个结果。

sentences.en: What I'm saying is I don't think that's the intent.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，我不认为那是我们的初衷。

sentences.en: I certainly believe what you're saying.
sentences.zh: 我当然相信你所说的。

sentences.en: I believe there are people that are afraid of being arrested by ICE because they're here illegally.
sentences.zh: 我相信确实有人因为非法居留而害怕被ICE逮捕。

sentences.en: I follow that.
sentences.zh: 我明白这一点。

sentences.en: I believe it.
sentences.zh: 我相信这一点。

sentences.en: But that's certainly not the intent.
sentences.zh: 但这绝对不是我们的初衷。

sentences.en: But if it leads to more people self-deporting in a more structured, controlled manner, then, you know, I hope they do.
sentences.zh: 但如果这能促使更多人以更有序、更可控的方式主动离境，那么，你知道，我希望他们这样做。

sentences.en: I hope they take advantage of it.
sentences.zh: 我希望他们能利用这个机会。

sentences.en: So recently we've seen some pushback surface from a very different constituency on this, which is big business.
sentences.zh: 最近我们看到一个非常不同的群体对此提出了反对意见，那就是大企业。

sentences.en: And quite unexpectedly, also the president, your boss, who gave voice to some of these anxieties.
sentences.zh: 而且出人意料的是，你的老板——总统先生，也表达了这些担忧。

sentences.en: Trump posted on social media this week that he's been hearing that the raids are having an impact on hotels and farmers.
sentences.zh: 特朗普本周在社交媒体上发文称，他听说这些突袭行动对酒店和农场主产生了影响。

sentences.en: I'm just going to quote from his poSt.
sentences.zh: 我引用一下他的帖子。

sentences.en: Our very aggressive immigration policy is taking very good longtime workers away from them with those jobs being almost impossible to replace.
sentences.zh: 我们非常激进的移民政策正在从他们那里带走非常优秀的长期员工，而这些职位几乎无法填补。

sentences.en: What did you think of that post?
sentences.zh: 你对这篇帖子怎么看？

sentences.en: Because from where I sit, it did look like the president saying, look, this approach that you've been taking, that ICE has been taking, is becoming a problem.
sentences.zh: 因为在我看来，这看起来像是总统在说：看，你们一直采取的这种做法，ICE一直采取的这种做法，正在成为一个问题。

sentences.en: Is that how you read it?
sentences.zh: 你是这样解读的吗？

sentences.en: I think what the president is getting to is that, again, I haven't discussed this with the president.
sentences.zh: 我认为总统想要表达的是，再说一次，我还没有和总统讨论过这个问题。

sentences.en: I just, you know, we haven't had a discussion, but I saw the poSt.
sentences.zh: 我只是，你知道，我们还没有进行过讨论，但我看到了那篇帖子。

sentences.en: And I've said for a long time, and I think we started this interview with this, Congress needs to make some changes, right?
sentences.zh: 我早就说过，我想我们这次采访开头也提到了，国会需要做出一些改变，对吧？

sentences.en: If we need a workforce to do that type of work, then create a legal pathway where they don't have to pay a smuggler.
sentences.zh: 如果我们确实需要劳动力来从事那种工作，那就创造一个合法的渠道，让他们不必去付钱给蛇头。

sentences.en: Then come with a visa and come here, work, do their job and go home, pay their taxes or whatever.
sentences.zh: 然后持签证过来，在这里工作，做好他们的工作，然后回家，缴纳他们的税款或其他什么。

sentences.en: I think the president understands that there's a broken system here, but it doesn't mean we just ignore the law.
sentences.zh: 我认为总统明白这里的制度已经崩溃了，但这并不意味着我们可以无视法律。

sentences.en: Just so we're clear, because I think there was a lot of confusion after this.
sentences.zh: 为了明确起见，因为我认为在这之后有很多困惑。

sentences.en: What is the policy?
sentences.zh: 现在的政策是什么？

sentences.en: Are you still doing the workplace raids?
sentences.zh: 你们还在进行工作场所突袭吗？

sentences.en: Because there was a lot of back and forth.
sentences.zh: 因为之前有很多反复的说法。

sentences.en: We are still doing workplace raids, but again, it's based on prioritization.
sentences.zh: 我们确实还在进行工作场所突袭，但再次强调，这是基于优先级的。

sentences.en: If there's a victim of trafficking or some of the financing going to other illegal ventures like cartel activity or drug smuggling.
sentences.zh: 如果涉及人口贩运的受害者，或者资金流向了其他非法活动，如卡特尔组织活动或毒品走私。

sentences.en: So if there's a violation of the law, we certainly prioritize those first because it's about the health and safety of the alien who's being abused.
sentences.zh: 所以如果存在违法行为，我们肯定会优先处理这些案件，因为这关乎受虐待者的健康和安全。

sentences.en: The worst firSt.
sentences.zh: 先处理最严重的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I want to talk about what's happening to people once they have been swept up in these raids.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈那些在突袭中被抓的人后来怎么样了。

sentences.en: They're taken into ICE custody where we've seen reports that they have no ability to contact their lawyers.
sentences.zh: 他们被带到了ICE的拘留所，据报道，他们无法联系律师。

sentences.en: We have heard about people who are being sent abroad to countries, you know, with which they have no connection, Sudan, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 我们听说有人被送往国外，送到了他们毫无关联的国家，比如苏丹等等。

sentences.en: Why are people being sent to countries, you know, where they have no connection?
sentences.zh: 为什么人们会被送往他们毫无关联的国家？

sentences.en: It's not their home.
sentences.zh: 那不是他们的家。

sentences.en: It's a case by case of cases.
sentences.zh: 这是具体情况具体分析。

sentences.en: If it's a significant public safety threat and their country won't take them back, well, they're not staying here.
sentences.zh: 如果他们对公共安全构成重大威胁，而他们的国家不愿接收他们，那么他们就不能留在这里。

sentences.en: If we have a third state of country willing to take them, we'll send them.
sentences.zh: 如果有第三国愿意接收他们，我们就会把他们送过去。

sentences.en: A vast majority of illegal aliens to be arrested, a vast majority, are removed to the country where they're a citizen national.
sentences.zh: 绝大多数被捕的非法移民，绝大多数，都被遣返回了他们拥有公民身份的国家。

sentences.en: But there are countries out there.
sentences.zh: 但确实存在一些国家。

sentences.en: We see Venezuela turn on and off many times.
sentences.zh: 我们看到委内瑞拉的态度变来变去。

sentences.en: No, we'll take them.
sentences.zh: 不，我们会接收他们。

sentences.en: No, we won't take them.
sentences.zh: 不，我们不会接收他们。

sentences.en: Well, if you don't take them, they're not staying here.
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果你不接收他们，他们就不能留在这里。

sentences.en: They're a public safety threat.
sentences.zh: 他们是对公共安全的威胁。

sentences.en: We'll send them someplace else.
sentences.zh: 我们会把他们送到别的地方去。

sentences.en: So we have other countries that are stepping up and say, look, we'll take them.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有其他国家站出来说，看，我们会接收他们。

sentences.en: We'll give them a place to settle down.
sentences.zh: 我们会给他们一个安身之所。

sentences.en: Are there, in your mind, any limits to what ICE would do to...
sentences.zh: 在你看来，ICE所做的事情有任何限制吗……

sentences.en: Of course there's limits.
sentences.zh: 当然有限制。

sentences.en: But we're not going to violate anybody's human rights.
sentences.zh: 但我们不会侵犯任何人的基本人权。

sentences.en: We're not going to violate the civil rights.
sentences.zh: 我们不会侵犯公民权利。

sentences.en: If someone's not allowed to call the attorney, give me an example.
sentences.zh: 如果有人不被允许给律师打电话，请给我一个例子。

sentences.en: Give me a case.
sentences.zh: 给我一个案例。

sentences.en: Give me where, when.
sentences.zh: 告诉我地点和时间。

sentences.en: And we'll look into it because certainly they have the right to contact their attorney.
sentences.zh: 我们会进行调查，因为他们当然有权联系他们的律师。

sentences.en: We try to treat everybody with dignity and we try to do things the right way.
sentences.zh: 我们努力以尊严对待每一个人，并努力以正确的方式做事。

sentences.en: Mr. Holman, last question here.
sentences.zh: 霍尔曼先生，最后一个问题。

sentences.en: You clearly think that these deportations benefit the United States, right?
sentences.zh: 你显然认为这些驱逐行动对美国有益，对吧？

sentences.en: That it makes it a safer place, that it makes it a place where American workers come first, where the rule of law is respected.
sentences.zh: 认为这让美国变得更安全，让美国成为一个美国工人优先、法治得到尊重的地方。

sentences.en: What some of these business leaders, these farmers, these hotel owners, and some politicians, including Republicans, are saying, wait a minute,
sentences.zh: 而一些商业领袖、农场主、酒店老板，以及包括共和党人在内的一些政客却说，等一下，

sentences.en: this actually might be bad for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这实际上可能对美国不利。

sentences.en: And to a degree, the protesters are saying the same thing on different grounds, but it's the same idea.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，抗议者们基于不同的理由也在说同样的话，但核心观点是一样的。

sentences.en: How do you know that you're right and that they're wrong?
sentences.zh: 你怎么知道你是对的，而他们是错的？

sentences.en: Look, you know, the senior leaders of this effort meet every day at 10 a.m.
sentences.zh: 看，你知道，这项工作的领导层每天上午10点都会开会。

sentences.en: We look at the effects of what we're doing.
sentences.zh: 我们审视我们所作所为的影响。

sentences.en: We take all these things into consideration.
sentences.zh: 我们把所有这些因素都考虑在内。

sentences.en: I've worked for six different presidents, starting with Ronald Reagan.
sentences.zh: 我为六位不同的总统工作过，从罗纳德·里根开始。

sentences.en: I've seen hundreds and hundreds of policies come and go.
sentences.zh: 我见过成百上千项政策的起起落落。

sentences.en: I see what works.
sentences.zh: 我知道什么有效。

sentences.en: I see what hasn't worked.
sentences.zh: 我知道什么无效。

sentences.en: We're working with a plan right now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在正按照计划行事。

sentences.en: We're using every tool in the two shed to keep President Trump's promise to American people.
sentences.zh: 我们正在动用工具箱里的每一种工具，以兑现特朗普总统对美国人民的承诺。

sentences.en: That's exactly what we're doing.
sentences.zh: 这正是我们正在做的。

sentences.en: Can plans be fluctuated?
sentences.zh: 计划可以调整吗？

sentences.en: Certainly.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: I was up on the Hill several times last week meeting with congressmen and senators.
sentences.zh: 上周我几次去国会山会见国会议员和参议员。

sentences.en: We're talking about fluctuations and messaging and different things we can do.
sentences.zh: 我们正在讨论调整、信息传达以及我们可以做的不同事情。

sentences.en: So it's a work in progress.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一项正在进行的工作。

sentences.en: And I certainly listen to all these people and will take all those ideas in consideration.
sentences.zh: 我当然会听取所有这些人的意见，并将所有这些想法纳入考量。

sentences.en: And in fact, we do.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们确实在这样做。

sentences.en: It's a work in progress.
sentences.zh: 这是一项正在进行的工作。

sentences.en: We'll keep working toward it.
sentences.zh: 我们将继续努力。

sentences.en: Mr. Holman, thank you so much for coming on the show.
sentences.zh: 霍尔曼先生，非常感谢你来到节目中。

sentences.en: You got it.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, President Trump said he hadn't made a final call about whether to order American forces to join Israel in its ongoing attacks on Iran's nuclear sites.
sentences.zh: 周三，特朗普总统表示，他尚未就是否下令美军加入以色列对伊朗核设施的持续袭击做出最终决定。

sentences.en: Iran's leader has warned the U.S.
sentences.zh: 伊朗领导人警告称，如果美国这样做，

sentences.en: would face irreparable harm if it did.
sentences.zh: 将面临不可挽回的损害。

sentences.en: At an Oval Office event, Trump said he had, quote, ideas as to what to do, adding, quote,
sentences.zh: 在白宫椭圆形办公室的一次活动中，特朗普表示他有，引用他的话，“关于该怎么做的想法”，并补充说，引用他的话，

sentences.en: And while the Supreme Leader of Iran rejected Trump's call for an unconditional surrender,
sentences.zh: 尽管伊朗最高领袖拒绝了特朗普关于无条件投降的要求，

sentences.en: a senior official told the Times Iran would accept an offer to sit down for talks to seek a negotiated way out of the conflict.
sentences.zh: 一位高级官员告诉《泰晤士报》，伊朗将接受坐下来谈判的提议，以寻求一种通过谈判解决冲突的出路。

sentences.en: And the Supreme Court upheld the Tennessee ban on medical treatment for transgender minors, shielding similar laws in more than 20 other states.
sentences.zh: 最高法院维持了田纳西州对跨性别未成年人医疗的禁令，从而保护了其他20多个州类似的法律。

sentences.en: The decision was a setback for proponents of transgender rights,
sentences.zh: 这一裁决对跨性别权利的支持者来说是一个挫折，

sentences.en: who just five years ago celebrated a different decision by the court to protect trans people from workplace discrimination.
sentences.zh: 他们仅仅在五年前还曾为法院保护跨性别者免受职场歧视的另一项裁决而欢呼。

sentences.en: The vote was 6-3, with the court's three liberal justices in dissent.
sentences.zh: 投票结果为6比3，法院的三位自由派大法官持异议。
